No video sample, menu screen, or spec sheet shown to confirm recording capability.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the top plate or front nameplate showing 'Nikon D5100' engraving, and the serial number sticker.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the top plate/front nameplate showing the Nikon model name and serial number.
Photo of the 18-55mm VR lens (mounted or separate) showing its printed model markings.
Video of the camera powering on, shutter firing, and the LCD displaying a live image.
Photo of included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, strap, and box contents.
response.reason: The photo does not show a legible model nameplate or the claimed lens, and the model/lens combination is what determines the price bracket for a Nikon DSLR kit, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a clearer identifying shot.
